92	| active | designing | a semantic change invalidates current design or plan |

104	## Eligibility and selection
105	
106	An issue is eligible only when all are true:
107	
108	1. It is open and is an executable leaf.
109	2. Its body satisfies the contract.
110	3. Its design authority is approved.

126	
127	Record the issue URL and `updatedAt` value consumed by a Superpowers plan.

131	invalidate the plan. Classify the change:

134	- Acceptance or scope change covered by the spec but absent from the plan:
135	  revise and approve the plan.
136	- Design change: return to Superpowers brainstorming and specification review.
137	- New blocker: move to `backplane:blocked` and record the reason.

140	
141	Do not mutate for a read-only request. For an authorized transition:
142	
143	1. Fetch current state and relationships.
144	2. Verify the expected revision and exactly one `backplane:*` label.
145	3. Apply the removal and addition in one `gh issue edit` invocation while
146	   preserving unrelated labels.

159	[product operation](product-decomposition.md). `Backplane Record` owns code/kind
160	and authority references; `Obligation Dispositions` owns parent accounting;
161	`Coverage and Satisfaction` owns current mappings and immutable evaluation
162	pointers. Preserve native relationships and the existing executable body/gates.
163	These sections do not silently migrate legacy issues.
164	
165	Project Code/Kind/Satisfaction and optional Status are derived presentations;
166	they do not override native lifecycle or accepted evidence. Missing custom types
167	need no new organization types. Declared integrated capture with denied Project
168	access is incomplete, not an implicit switch to explicitly selected issues-only.
169	Read-only proposals authorize no body, relationship, label, PR, or Project write.
170	
171	A changed criterion or delivery input requires affected evaluation reconciliation;
172	keep historical evidence at its original identity. Unsupported satisfaction is
173	UNKNOWN; a known unmet check is UNSATISFIED. Deferred/excluded scope is separate.
174	Use the PR closeout operation before justified completion, and the checkpoint
175	operation for its separately authorized portable record. Observed automatic
176	closure does not prove satisfaction or authorize unrequested reopening.

179	state. Neutral contribution references remain distinct from closing intent and
180	observed native closure. Report a prematurely closed issue's actual state and
181	failed/unknown obligations; only the authorized recovery operation may change it.

12	  -> approved issue design or docs/superpowers/specs artifact
13	  -> superpowers:writing-plans
14	  -> Superpowers execution and TDD
15	  -> Superpowers review and verification
16	  -> integration, evidence, and GitHub closure
17	```

19	## Design authority decision
20	
21	Use a human-approved issue body as design authority when the work is bounded,
22	the issue contract is complete, and implementation does not introduce an
23	architectural, cross-cutting, or breaking decision.
24

26	the work changes architecture, spans multiple independently reviewable
27	subsystems, introduces a breaking contract, or requires design reasoning that
28	would be obscured in an issue body.
29

31	issue. Do use brainstorming to resolve missing or newly changed design.
32

34

36	constraints must record:
37	
38	- Issue URL.
39	- Issue `updatedAt` revision consumed.
40	- Design authority: issue body or specification path.
41	- Acceptance criteria and verification seams as hard constraints.
42	- Exact project-owned verification commands.
43	
44	The plan is execution authority, not the backlog master. A checked task records
45	plan progress only.
46

48

50	- Move any open state to `backplane:blocked` when a concrete unresolved
51	  condition stops progress; record its prior valid state as the resume target

53	- Move active work to `backplane:review` when implementation, relevant review,

57	  changes.
58	- Close completed only after the integrated target passes fresh verification.

61	release rules, and deployment authority. Backplane must read those rules and

81	planning results to proposed/existing native work before per-issue planning.
